### What this is

AbarVa builds a **secure context layer** over your enterprise technology, sourcing, and transformation data — then uses **Intelligence**, **Moves**, and **Source** to help your leadership team make better decisions faster.

The **90-day pilot** ($300K) proves whether that context layer can surface real savings, de-risk initiatives, and create board-ready decision artifacts quickly enough to justify a **$750K / year enterprise contract** in Year 1.

### The 90-day shape

| Phase | Weeks | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| **0 — Security + Warmup** | 0-2 | Stand up dedicated Azure private tenant; load synthetic + de-identified PHS-like data; train 5 named users; InfoSec review runs in parallel |
| **1 — Context Layer** | 2-5 | Ingest 8-10 enterprise domains: CMDB, contracts, IT spend, initiatives, governance docs, strategic plans, procurement pipeline, deidentified ops metrics |
| **2 — Decision Workflows** | 5-10 | Run 3-4 high-value workflows: AI/data modernization synthesis · 1-2 strategic Moves · 1 sourcing event · board-ready artifacts |
| **3 — Conversion Case** | 10-13 | Executive readout: quantified value surfaced + risks avoided + sourcing leverage + 12-month roadmap + Year-1 proposal |

### Conversion criteria (all seven for $750K Year-1)

1. **Context depth** — 8-10 major domains mapped
2. **Decision quality** — 3+ leadership-grade recommendations citing PHS-specific evidence
3. **Value surfaced** — $1.5M-$3M identified savings / waste avoided / vendor leverage / risk reduced
4. **Speed** — major decisions framed in days, not weeks
5. **Security** — InfoSec approves production use for agreed data classes
6. **Adoption** — 5-8 named leaders rate output as "decision-useful"
7. **Renewal path** — 12-month operating model agreed (users, refresh, governance, top use cases)

### Data + security posture

- **No PHI required for Day-75 value.** Synthetic + de-identified carries the pilot.
- **InfoSec review runs in parallel from Day 1** — architecture, HIPAA, data flow, BAA/DPA, encryption, access, audit logs, AI egress controls.
- **AbarVa Azure private data lane** for the pilot — dedicated tenant, RLS-isolated, encrypted, audit-logged.
- **"No training on customer data" posture** — contractually committed.
- **AWS portability lab in Week 1** — parallel confidence-building track. If AWS-residency is your Year-1 hard requirement, we already have the path.

### What we ask from PHS to start

1. **90-day pilot sponsor** (Year-1 commit authority)
2. **5 named users** (CDAO + CIO/IT + procurement + transformation + clinical rep)
3. **3 priority decisions / use cases** — these become the Phase 2 workflows
4. **InfoSec contact** for the parallel review
5. **Procurement / contract lead** for SOW + BAA execution
6. **Permission to use synthetic + de-identified warmup data** during Phase 0
7. **Phased data access list** matching the Phase 0-3 graduation
8. **Agreement that conversion is based on the seven criteria above**

### Three FAQs you'll get asked

**Q1: "Why not just hire Deloitte for an AI strategy study?"**
> Deloitte gives you a 200-slide deck that goes stale in six months. AbarVa gives you a decision spine that auto-refreshes as your data updates, with full evidence provenance back to the source document. Same deliverable shape, very different half-life. We don't replace Deloitte for political work or narrative cover — we replace them for the synthesis work that should have been built on your data anyway.

**Q2: "What happens to PHI? You're a healthcare org, this is the hardest question."**
> Day-75 value is fully achievable without PHI. The first 75 days run on synthetic + de-identified + cleared-class data only. PHI ingestion is gated behind an explicit Phase 3 milestone that requires your AI Governance Committee + Legal + InfoSec sign-off on a specific data class. Default: pilot completes without PHI.

**Q3: "We use Epic / Workday / MedeAnalytics — do you replace any of them?"**
> No. We sit ABOVE them. Epic stays. Workday stays. MedeAnalytics stays. We give your CDAO + CIO a synthesis layer that PULLS from all of those (via flat exports during pilot; native integrations during Year-1) and produces decision artifacts. Think of us as the layer your team would build if they had 18 months and $4M of headcount — except you get Day-30 value instead.
